title: BoomTNT
description: BoomTNT replaces boring vanilla TNT with four absolutely chaotic explosives. No block damage? Wrong. Swapping your friend's house with lava? Yes. Turning every cow into a creeper? Absolutely.
body:
The 4 Explosives
Swapper TNT ==> Swaps every block in a 5-block radius with another random block inside the same area.

Cowpult TNT ==> Spawns 15 random farm animals (cow, pig, chicken, sheep) that fly outward with high speed.

Creeper Plague TNT ==> All mobs within a 10-block radius instantly turn into ordinary creepers.


Soundcloud TNT ==> No block damage. Every mob within 15 blocks starts moving randomly (chaotic dance) for 10 seconds. Plays a random loud sound (crit, villager celebration, creeper hiss, explosion, beacon activate) and shakes the screen.
